fields.title: 📖 Muḥkam and Mutashābih: the foundation before Fitna
fields.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“In the Book there are clear verses that are the foundation, and others that are ambiguous. Whoever has deviation in the heart follows the ambiguous, seeking Fitna.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** In Ḥākimiyyah one must not tear single terms out of their context. The clear foundations of the Salaf govern the ambiguous passages.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī, Tafsīr zu Sūrah Āl ʿImrān 3:7.
